def Array.size.node(-T: Type, ys: Array<T>, r: Array<T> & U32) ->
  Array<T> & U32:
  (xs2, n) = r
  (ANode{xs2, ys}, U32.shl(n))

def Array.size(-T: Type, a: Array<T>) -> Array<T> & U32:
  match a:
    case ALeaf{x}:
      (ALeaf{x}, 1)
    case ANode{xs, ys}:
      Array.size.node(T, ys, Array.size(T, xs))
